title: Orbs seen with unmarked black helicopters

tellings.quote: you guys often see or sometimes see are orbs accompanied by these unmarked black helicopters.

plain: At Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange happenings, glowing orbs are sometimes seen along with unmarked black helicopters. Michels says this to the ranch's owner as something the people there "often see or sometimes see." It suggests that someone with aircraft is taking an interest in whatever the orbs are.
